newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank governor says no plan to quit.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank governor says no plan to quit.

text.p: Thai central bank governor Rerngchai Marakanond on Thursday denied market rumours that he may follow Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan by quitting his job.
Rerngchai told reporters after meeting Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh at Government House that he sought a meeting with the premier to brief him on the Thai economy. He did not elaborate.
Their meeting came after Amnuay tendered his resignation to Chavalit. Rerngchai earlier met Amnuay at his home on Wednesday night when the outgoing finance minister reportedly decided to quit.
